description: One-way ratchet on type escapes, counted from the TypeScript AST by scripts/audit-type-escapes.mjs. Every file carrying escapes is frozen at its current count in scan.baseline as [explicitAny, asAny, suppressions]: counts may fall freely, any increase fails, and a file with no entry must introduce none. totals.typeEscapeCeiling is the backlog as a single number and may only fall. Lower a baseline in the same change that removes the escapes — leaving headroom lets it refill silently. Phase 2.3 (API / service boundary typing) rebuilt the baseline at its earned value: the route, POS, report-shard, raw-SQL, migration and injected db/tx/pool boundaries now carry named contracts, and the ceiling falls from 2208 to 1775.
